purpose: Grants, revokes and reads who may use a whole vault, and shares that vault so a person can add records there.
namedChanges: 0.1.2. `NO_CONTROL` (the 403 sentence) is exported; the message a 403 gives is unchanged

The imports: `vaultOriginOf` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-vault-origin-rule`; `dpopReadAuth`, `dpopWriteAuth` and `invalidateDpop` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-lws-session-bridge`; `serverErrorText` from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-server-error`. In the source these are `./config`, `./dpop` and `./serverError`. The three URL constants are functions in this file, built from `vaultOriginOf` at each call.
The short-WebID example on `VaultAclEntry` named a host. The example is removed. No code changed.
Comments: cycle, ticket and person tags are removed.
`postGrant` returns the parsed body, so a caller can read the principal the platform echoes. `grantVaultAccess` and `revokeVaultAccess` still return `Promise<void>`.

`shareVault` and `unshareVault` are new, and so is the type `VaultShareLevel`. View grants read. Edit grants write, reads the access list, and matches `grantee` from the grant's body. `unshareVault` revokes write, then read, then append, because revoking write leaves the planted read.

library.title: Vault access (grant, revoke, share a whole vault)
library.note: Who may use a whole vault: grant, revoke, read the access list, share to view or edit. For a share of one record take lws-relations; for which vaults you can reach take reachable-vaults. Exports the Control refusal sentence (NO_CONTROL).
